topic: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine

en.headline: US approves $2.1B sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
en.body: The US State Department approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC-3 MSE Patriot interceptors to Ukraine on Friday, Oct. 30. The sale was reported by The Kyiv Post and The Jerusalem Post.

fr.headline: Les États-Unis approuvent la vente de 2,1 milliards de dollars de 500 missiles Patriot
fr.body: Le Département d'État des États-Unis a approuvé le 30 octobre une vente de 2,1 milliards de dollars de 500 intercepteurs Patriot PAC-3 MSE à l’Ukraine. La vente a été rapportée par The Kyiv Post et The Jerusalem Post.

it.headline: Gli Stati Uniti approvano la vendita di 500 missili Patriot per 2,1 miliardi di dollari all’Ucraina
it.body: Il Dipartimento di Stato degli Stati Uniti ha approvato la vendita di 500 intercettori Patriot PAC‑3 MSE per 2,1 miliardi di dollari all’Ucraina venerdì 30 ottobre. La notizia è stata riportata da The Kyiv Post e The Jerusalem Post.

de.headline: USA genehmigt Verkauf von 500 Patriot-Missilen im Wert von 2,1 Mrd. USD an die Ukraine
de.body: Das US-Außenministerium hat am Freitag, dem 30. Oktober, einen Verkauf von 500 PAC-3 MSE Patriot-Interzeptoren im Wert von 2,1 Mrd. USD an die Ukraine genehmigt. Die Transaktion wurde von der Kyiv Post und der Jerusalem Post berichtet.

es.headline: EEUU aprueba la venta de 500 misiles Patriot por 2,1 mil millones de dólares a Ucrania
es.body: El Departamento de Estado de EE. UU. aprobó una venta de 2,1 mil millones de dólares de 500 interceptores Patriot PAC‑3 MSE a Ucrania el viernes 30 de octubre. La operación fue informada por The Kyiv Post y The Jerusalem Post.

zh.headline: 美国批准21亿美元出售500枚爱国者导弹给乌克兰
zh.body: 美国国务院于10月30日星期五批准向乌克兰出售500枚PAC-3 MSE爱国者拦截导弹，总额21亿美元。该交易由《基辅邮报》和《耶路撒冷邮报》报道。

pt.headline: EUA aprovam venda de 500 mísseis Patriot por US$2,1 B à Ucrânia
pt.body: O Departamento de Estado dos EUA aprovou uma venda de 500 interceptores PAC-3 MSE Patriot por US$2,1 B à Ucrânia na sexta‑feira, 30 de outubro. A venda foi reportada pelo The Kyiv Post e pelo The Jerusalem Post.

ja.headline: 米国、ウクライナへのパトリオットミサイル500発販売を21億ドルで承認
ja.body: 米国国務省は10月30日金曜日、PAC-3 MSEパトリオットインターセプター500発をウクライナへ21億ドルで販売することを承認しました。報道はキエビポストとエルサレムポストで報じられました。

ko.headline: 미국, 우크라이나에 500개 파트리어트 미사일 21억 달러 매각 승인
ko.body: 미국 국무부는 10월 30일(금) 500개의 PAC-3 MSE 파트리어트 인터셉터를 우크라이나에 21억 달러에 매각하는 것을 승인했습니다. 이 매각 소식은 키이프 포스트와 예루살렘 포스트에서 보도되었습니다.

sources.title: US Formally Approves $2.1B Sale of 500 Patriot Missiles to Ukraine
US approves $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine amid delayed missile deliveries

en.headline: Sale of 500 Patriot missiles funded by Western partners and allies
en.body: The sale is funded entirely by Western partners and allies, including Canada, Germany, and Norway, according to The Kyiv Post and SRF.

fr.headline: La vente de 500 missiles Patriot est financée par des partenaires et alliés occidentaux
fr.body: La vente est entièrement financée par des partenaires et alliés occidentaux, dont le Canada, l’Allemagne et la Norvège, selon The Kyiv Post et SRF.

it.headline: Vendita di 500 missili Patriot finanziata da partner e alleati occidentali
it.body: La vendita è finanziata interamente da partner e alleati occidentali, tra cui Canada, Germania e Norvegia, secondo The Kyiv Post e SRF.

de.headline: Verkauf von 500 Patriot-Missilen wird von westlichen Partnern und Verbündeten finanziert
de.body: Der Verkauf wird laut der Kyiv Post und SRF vollständig von westlichen Partnern und Verbündeten, darunter Kanada, Deutschland und Norwegen, finanziert.

es.headline: La venta de 500 misiles Patriot financiada por socios y aliados occidentales
es.body: La venta está financiada en su totalidad por socios y aliados occidentales, incluidos Canadá, Alemania y Noruega, según The Kyiv Post y SRF.

zh.headline: 500枚爱国者导弹的销售由西方伙伴和盟友资助
zh.body: 据《基辅邮报》和SRF报道，该销售完全由西方伙伴和盟友资助，包括加拿大、德国和挪威。

pt.headline: Venda de 500 mísseis Patriot financiada por parceiros e aliados ocidentais
pt.body: A venda é financiada inteiramente por parceiros e aliados ocidentais, incluindo Canadá, Alemanha e Noruega, segundo o The Kyiv Post e o SRF.

ja.headline: 500発パトリオットミサイル販売は西側パートナーと同盟国の資金で賄われる
ja.body: 販売はカナダ、ドイツ、ノルウェーを含む西側パートナーと同盟国の資金のみで賄われると、キエビポストとSRFが報じています。

ko.headline: 500개 파트리어트 미사일 매각은 서방 파트너와 동맹국이 전액 자금 지원
ko.body: 키이프 포스트와 SRF에 따르면, 이 매각은 캐나다, 독일, 노르웨이를 포함한 서방 파트너와 동맹국이 전액을 자금 지원합니다.

fr.title: Les États-Unis approuvent la vente de 500 missiles Patriot à l'Ukraine

it.title: Gli Stati Uniti approvano la vendita di 500 missili Patriot all'Ucraina
it.dek: Gli Stati Uniti hanno formalmente approvato una vendita di 2,1 miliardi di dollari di 500 sistemi missilistici Patriot all'Ucraina, segnando un'importante escalation nel supporto militare in mezzo al conflitto in corso.

pt.dek: Os Estados Unidos aprovaram formalmente uma venda de 500 sistemas de mísseis Patriot no valor de 2,1 bilhões de dólares à Ucrânia, marcando uma escalada significativa no apoio militar no contexto do conflito em curso.

zh.title: 美国批准向乌克兰出售500套爱国者导弹
zh.dek: 美国正式批准向乌克兰出售500套爱国者导弹系统，总额21亿美元，这标志着在持续冲突中军事支持的显著升级。

ja.title: 米国、ウクライナへのパトリオットミサイル500発販売を承認
ja.dek: 米国は正式に500発のパトリオットミサイルシステムをウクライナに販売する21億ドル（2.1 billionドル）の取引を承認し、継続中の紛争における軍事支援の大幅な拡大を示した。

ko.title: 미국, 우크라이나에 파트리오트 미사일 500대 판매 승인
ko.dek: 미국은 공식적으로 500대 파트리오트 미사일 시스템을 우크라이나에 판매하는 21억 달러 규모의 거래를 승인했으며, 이는 지속되는 갈등 속에서 군사 지원이 크게 확대된 것을 의미한다

en.title: US approves $2.1B sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
en.dek: The U.S. State Department approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC‑3 MSE Patriot interceptors to Ukraine, funded by Western allies.
facts: The U.S. State Department approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC‑3 MSE Patriot interceptors to Ukraine.
The approval was announced on 30 October 2026.
The sale is funded entirely by Western partners and allies, including Canada, Germany, and Norway.
The missiles are PAC‑3 MSE models.
body: The U.S. State Department approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC‑3 MSE Patriot interceptors to Ukraine on 30 October 2026. The approval was announced by the State Department. The decision was reported by The Kyiv Post and The Jerusalem Post.
The Kyiv Post and The Jerusalem Post both reported the approval on the same day. Both outlets cited the State Department as the source. The articles were published at 21:30 UTC.
The sale is funded entirely by Western partners and allies. The funding includes contributions from Canada, Germany, and Norway. The information was provided by SRF and The Kyiv Post.
According to SRF, the funding arrangement means the U.S. does not provide the money for the missiles. The U.S. is only responsible for the sale.
The sale involves 500 Patriot missiles. The missiles are PAC‑3 MSE models. The article title mentions 500 missiles.
PAC‑3 MSE is a type of interceptor missile. The article title refers to them as Patriot interceptors. The sale is for these interceptors.
en.context: The sale involves PAC‑3 MSE Patriot interceptors, a type of missile used for air defense. The U.S. State Department approved the sale on 30 October 2026.
